research.notes: The organization found is based in Little Rock, Arkansas, but the agenda says Oakland, CA. The name and an OUSD partner listing match, but the location does not, so this is not confirmed as high confidence. No CA Secretary of State, EIN or SAM.gov registry records were checked. profile.summary: Village Public Health is a public health education business in Little Rock, Arkansas. It offers youth ages 13 to 24 health coaching, mental health education, healthy relationships training and workforce development programs. It grew out of Mumford and Associates, a health education consulting firm.
